answer: Draw each answer's grading panel by random sortition weighted toward identities with a track record of real work, using an unpredictable beacon so no one can pick their own jury. A sybil operator cannot harbor a friendly panel of its own puppets; the draw reaches across the whole terrace of participants and lands on established workers far more often than on day-old shells. The deeper, sable layers of proven history hold the votes, and a cluster of fakes almost never controls the seats that decide finality.
